# Third-party notices

The documentation site uses Zensical and its supplied theme assets. These components retain their own licenses; the project MIT license does not replace them.

The following files are copied unchanged from the locked Zensical distribution. Icon notices are retained for all supplied families, even when only a subset is used by a particular build.

- [zensical-MIT.txt](zensical-MIT.txt)
- [javascript-NOTICES.txt](javascript-NOTICES.txt)
- [icons-fontawesome-LICENSE.txt](icons-fontawesome-LICENSE.txt)
- [icons-octicons-LICENSE.txt](icons-octicons-LICENSE.txt)
- [icons-material-LICENSE.txt](icons-material-LICENSE.txt)
- [icons-simple-LICENSE.txt](icons-simple-LICENSE.txt)
- [icons-lucide-LICENSE.txt](icons-lucide-LICENSE.txt)

[Supplier paths and SHA-256 checksums](inventory.json). The generated site also retains the original JavaScript notices at `assets/javascripts/LICENSE`.

Python runtime dependencies are installed as separate distributions. They are not embedded in the project wheel. Their own license files remain in those distributions.

These notices grant no rights to redistribute Tushare data.

## Bundled JavaScript dependency texts

These files come from the exact package releases named by the supplier notice. Archive integrity was checked against npm metadata; no package scripts were executed.
